meals.name: Sticky honey-garlic chicken and broccoli over rice
steps: Cook 1½ cups rice. Whisk 3 Tbsp soy sauce, 3 Tbsp honey, 1 Tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger (or ½ tsp ground), ½ tsp red pepper flakes, 1 Tbsp cornstarch and ⅓ cup water.
Cut 1½ lb chicken breast into 1-inch pieces and toss with a pinch of salt. Sear in 1 Tbsp oil over high heat, 5–6 minutes, until browned and 165°F; move to a plate.
Add 1 Tbsp oil and 1½ lb broccoli florets with 3 Tbsp water; cover and steam-fry 3 minutes until bright green and crisp-tender.
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce and toss 1–2 minutes until thick and glossy. Serve over rice with sliced green onions.

meals.name: Smoky chipotle chicken tinga tostadas with avocado-lime crema
steps: Simmer 1½ lb chicken breasts in salted water with a bouillon cube, covered, 15–18 minutes until 165°F. Shred and save ½ cup of the broth.

Sauté 1 sliced onion in 1 Tbsp oil 5 minutes; add 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp oregano for 30 seconds. Blend or mash 1 lb chopped tomatoes with 2–3 chipotles plus 1 Tbsp adobo, add to the pan and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the chicken and reserved broth; simmer 5 minutes until saucy. Season with salt and a squeeze of lime.
Mash 2 avocados with ½ cup sour cream, the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt. Pile chicken on tostadas and top with crema and cilantro.

meals.name: Brown-butter pork chops with honey-mustard pan sauce and roasted sweet potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cube 2 lb sweet potatoes, toss with 1 Tbsp oil, ½ tsp smoked paprika, salt and pepper, and roast 25–30 minutes, flipping once.
Season 4 center-cut pork chops (about 2 lb) with salt, pepper and ½ tsp thyme. Sear in 1 Tbsp oil and 1 Tbsp butter over medium-high, 4–5 minutes per side, until 145°F. Rest on a plate.

Lower heat; add 2 Tbsp butter and 2 minced garlic cloves, cook until the butter smells nutty, then whisk in 1 Tbsp flour, ¾ cup broth, 2 Tbsp mustard and 1 Tbsp honey. Simmer 2–3 minutes until it coats a spoon.
Spoon the sauce over the chops and serve with the sweet potatoes.

meals.name: Greek lemon-oregano salmon with blistered tomatoes, green beans and feta orzo
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cook 1 cup orzo in salted water until tender; drain.
Whisk 3 Tbsp olive oil, the zest and juice of 1 lemon, 3 minced garlic cloves, 2 tsp oregano, ¼ tsp red pepper flakes, salt and pepper.

On a sheet pan, toss 1 lb green beans and 10 oz tomatoes with half the dressing. Nestle in 1½ lb salmon, cut into 4 pieces, and brush with the rest. Roast 12–15 minutes, until the salmon flakes and reaches 145°F.
Toss the orzo with crumbled feta and any pan juices. Serve with the salmon and vegetables.

meals.name: Spicy sausage and kale stuffed shells in garlicky tomato sauce
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Boil a 12 oz box of jumbo shells 2 minutes less than the package says; drain.
Brown 1 lb sausage in 1 Tbsp olive oil, 7–8 minutes, until 160°F. Add 4 minced garlic cloves, ½ tsp red pepper flakes and 4 cups chopped kale; cook until wilted. Cool slightly.
Stir together 15 oz ricotta, 1 egg, ½ cup parmesan, 1 cup shredded mozzarella, 1 tsp Italian seasoning and the sausage mixture.

Simmer the crushed tomatoes with 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp Italian seasoning 5 minutes; spread half in a 9x13 dish. Fill the shells, set them in, top with the remaining sauce and 1 cup mozzarella. Cover and bake 25 minutes, then uncover 10 minutes until bubbly.

meals.name: Coconut curry butternut squash and chickpea stew (meatless)
steps: Cook 1 cup rice. Peel and cube a 2½ lb butternut squash.
Soften 1 diced onion in 2 Tbsp oil, 5 minutes. Add 4 garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp grated ginger (or 1 tsp ground), 2 Tbsp curry powder, 1 tsp cumin and 2 Tbsp tomato paste; stir 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the squash, drained chickpeas, the coconut milk and 1 cup broth. Simmer, partly covered, 20 minutes until the squash is tender.
Stir in 2 big handfuls of chopped kale for 3 minutes, then season with salt and lime juice. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Brown sugar–mustard glazed ham with cheesy scalloped potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Set the ham in a foil-lined pan with ½ cup water, cover with foil and bake about 12 minutes per lb until it reaches 140°F (it comes fully cooked).
Melt 3 Tbsp butter, whisk in 3 Tbsp flour, then 2½ cups milk, ½ tsp each garlic powder and onion powder, 1 tsp salt and pepper. Simmer until thick, then stir in 1½ cups shredded cheese.

Layer 3 lb thinly sliced potatoes in a greased 9x13 dish with the sauce. Cover and bake alongside the ham 45 minutes, then uncover, top with ½ cup cheese and bake 20–25 minutes until tender and golden.

For the glaze, mix ½ cup brown sugar, 2 Tbsp mustard, 1 Tbsp vinegar, 2 Tbsp melted butter and ½ tsp smoked paprika. Brush on the ham for the last 20 minutes, uncovered. Slice and serve, and save the leftovers for sandwiches.

meals.name: Crab cake sliders with Old Bay remoulade and tangy slaw
buy: Old Bay seasoning (if not on hand)
steps: Bake 36 mini crab cakes as the package directs until hot and crisp (165°F inside).
Remoulade: stir ⅓ cup mayo, 1 Tbsp Dijon, 1 Tbsp chopped pickles, 1 tsp Old Bay, 1 tsp hot sauce and 1 tsp lemon juice.
Slaw: toss the coleslaw mix with 2 Tbsp mayo, 1 Tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, ½ tsp Old Bay, salt and pepper; rest 10 minutes.
Toast the buns, then layer each with remoulade, 1–2 crab cakes and a spoonful of slaw.

meals.name: Garlic-chili tonkotsu ramen bowls with crispy pork, corn and soft eggs
pantry: red pepper flakes or chili crisp
steps: Boil 4 eggs 6½ minutes, chill in ice water and peel.
Brown ½ lb ground pork in 1 tsp oil until crispy and 160°F; add 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sugar and cook 1 minute. Push aside and char 1 cup corn for 2 minutes.
Warm 2 Tbsp oil with 2 sliced garlic cloves and 1 tsp red pepper flakes just until the garlic turns golden; stir in 1 tsp sesame oil.
Cook 4 packs of ramen with their soup bases as directed. Top each bowl with pork, corn, a halved egg, green onions and a drizzle of the garlic-chili oil.

meals.name: Ginger–star anise broth with pho soup dumplings, rice noodles and bok choy
steps: Char a halved onion and a 2-inch piece of sliced ginger in a dry pot 4 minutes. Add 8 cups broth, 2 star anise, 1 cinnamon stick, 2 smashed garlic cloves, 2 Tbsp soy or fish sauce and 1 tsp brown sugar; simmer 20 minutes, then strain.
Soak or cook 8 oz rice noodles as the package directs; divide among bowls.
Bring the broth to a gentle simmer, add halved bok choy for 2 minutes, then steam or microwave the soup dumplings as the package directs (until steaming hot).
Ladle broth and bok choy over the noodles, add 9 dumplings per bowl and finish with lime, sliced jalapeño, herbs and sriracha or hoisin.
